## DESeq2

```{r de-methods, results='asis'}
if (is_lrt) {
  cat("\n\nLikelihood-ratio tests (LRT) across nested full/reduced designs. ",
      "Significant genes (`padj < alpha`) are clustered with ",
      "`DEGreport::degPatterns()` (x = time; colour = grouping factor when present).\n\n", sep = "")
  deseq2reports::emit_code_block(
    caption = "Reproduce LRT differential testing with:",
    "diffexp_out <- run_diffexp_lrt_pipeline(dds_qc, var = \"genotype\", time = \"time\")",
    "degpatterns_out <- run_degpatterns_pipeline(dds_qc, diffexp_out, time = \"time\", var = \"genotype\")"
  )
} else {
  deseq2reports::emit_code_block(
    caption = "Reproduce differential expression with this package module:",
    "diffexp_out <- run_diffexp_pipeline(dds_qc, var = \"condition\")"
  )
}
if (!is.null(params$ppi_out)) {
  deseq2reports::emit_code_block(
    caption = "Reproduce PPI connectivity (embedded below per contrast) with:",
    "ppi_out <- run_ppi_pipeline(diffexp_out = diffexp_out)"
  )
}
if (!is.null(params$cspa_out)) {
  if (is_lrt) {
    deseq2reports::emit_code_block(
      caption = "Reproduce CSPA surface-marker heatmaps with:",
      "cspa_out <- run_lrt_cspa_heatmap(dds_qc, degpatterns_out)"
    )
  } else {
    deseq2reports::emit_code_block(
      caption = "Reproduce CSPA surface-marker heatmaps with:",
      "cspa_out <- run_cspa_marker_pipeline(dds_qc, diffexp_out, var = \"condition\")"
    )
  }
}
```

```{r de-helpers, include=FALSE}
# CSPA heatmap HTML/PDF sizes are ~65% of the previous formula.
.cspa_plot_dims <- function(n_samples, n_markers, combined = FALSE) {
  w <- max(6, 0.25 * n_samples + 2) * 0.65
  h <- max(4, 0.22 * max(1, n_markers) + 2) * 0.65
  if (isTRUE(combined)) {
    list(width = min(w, 10 * 0.65), height = min(h, 12 * 0.65))
  } else {
    list(width = w, height = h)
  }
}

emit_ppi_block <- function(ppi, label, from_contrast_dir = FALSE) {
  if (is.null(ppi) || is.null(ppi$plot)) return(invisible(NULL))
  cat("\n\n##### PPI connectivity: ", label, "\n\n", sep = "")
  cat("\n\nSTRING subgraph among seed genes. Top hubs stay labelled; ",
      "degree-capped at ", if (!is.null(ppi$max_plot_nodes)) ppi$max_plot_nodes else 50,
      " nodes.\n\n", sep = "")
  ppi_btn <- deseq2reports::download_plot_button(
    ppi$plot, filename = paste0(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]+", "_", label), "_ppi"),
    width = 6.5, height = 5.5
  )
  deseq2reports::emit_widget_with_download(
    deseq2reports::make_interactive_ppi(ppi$plot),
    ppi_btn, center = TRUE
  )
}

emit_lrt_contrast <- function(comp, res_df, alpha, from_contrast_dir = FALSE) {
  n_sig <- sum(res_df$sig, na.rm = TRUE)
  cat("\n\n**", n_sig, "significant genes** (padj <", alpha,
      "). LRT has no single fold-change; `stat` is the likelihood-ratio chi-square.\n\n")

  specs <- params$diffexp_out$lrt_specs
  if (is.null(specs)) specs <- params$diffexp_out$contrast_specs
  if (!is.null(specs) && comp %in% specs$label) {
    row <- specs[specs$label == comp, , drop = FALSE][1, ]
    deseq2reports::emit_code_block(
      caption = "Full vs reduced design for this LRT:",
      paste0("full    <- ", row$full),
      paste0("reduced <- ", row$reduced),
      paste0("# tested terms: ", row$test_terms)
    )
  }

  cat("\n\n##### LRT results table\n\n")
  show <- res_df[order(res_df$padj, na.last = TRUE), , drop = FALSE]
  show <- utils::head(show[!is.na(show$padj), , drop = FALSE], 50L)
  deg_csv <- if (from_contrast_dir) {
    paste0(comp, "_lrt.csv")
  } else {
    file.path(comp, paste0(comp, "_lrt.csv"))
  }
  deg_btn <- deseq2reports::link_output_file(deg_csv, label = "Download full CSV")
  deseq2reports::emit_widget_with_download(
    deseq2reports::make_deg_datatable(show), deg_btn
  )

  dp <- params$degpatterns_out[[comp]]
  if (!is.null(dp) && isTRUE(dp$pass)) {
    cat("\n\n##### degPatterns clusters\n\n")
    cat("\n\nTemporal expression patterns among significant genes ",
        "(", dp$n_clusters, " cluster(s) from ", dp$n_sig, " genes).\n\n", sep = "")
    dp_pdf <- if (from_contrast_dir) {
      "degpatterns_clusters.pdf"
    } else {
      file.path(comp, "degpatterns_clusters.pdf")
    }
    if (inherits(dp$plot, "ggplot")) {
      deseq2reports::emit_plot_with_download(
        dp$plot,
        filename = paste0(comp, "_degpatterns"),
        width = 8, height = 6
      )
    } else {
      deseq2reports::emit_widget(
        deseq2reports::link_output_file(dp_pdf, label = "Download degPatterns PDF")
      )
    }
    if (!is.null(dp$df) && nrow(dp$df)) {
      cat("\n\n###### Cluster membership\n\n")
      cl_csv <- if (from_contrast_dir) {
        "degpatterns_clusters.csv"
      } else {
        file.path(comp, "degpatterns_clusters.csv")
      }
      cl_btn <- deseq2reports::link_output_file(cl_csv, label = "Download clusters CSV")
      deseq2reports::emit_widget_with_download(
        deseq2reports::make_gsea_datatable(utils::head(dp$df, 100L), page_length = 10),
        cl_btn
      )
    }
  } else if (!is.null(dp)) {
    cat("\n\n##### degPatterns\n\nSkipped or no clusters (n_sig = ",
        dp$n_sig, ").\n\n", sep = "")
  }

  # PPI for this LRT's temporal clusters — Bootstrap tabset (one module per tab)
  if (!is.null(params$ppi_out$by_module)) {
    mods <- names(params$ppi_out$by_module)
    hit <- mods[grepl(comp, mods, fixed = TRUE)]
    hit <- hit[vapply(hit, function(m) {
      !is.null(params$ppi_out$by_module[[m]]$plot)
    }, logical(1))]
    if (length(hit)) {
      cat("\n\n##### PPI connectivity by cluster\n\n")
      cat("\n\nSTRING subgraph among genes in each degPatterns cluster. ",
          "Use the tabs to show one cluster network at a time.\n\n", sep = "")
      short_labs <- sub("^.* cluster ", "cluster ", hit)
      # Prefer short "cluster N" labels when they stay unique
      if (anyDuplicated(short_labs) || any(!nzchar(short_labs))) {
        short_labs <- hit
      }
      tab_id <- paste0("lrt-ppi-", gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "-", comp))
      pane_ids <- deseq2reports::bs_tabset_start(tab_id, short_labs)
      for (i in seq_along(hit)) {
        m <- hit[i]
        deseq2reports::bs_tab_pane_start(pane_ids[i], active = (i == 1L))
        ppi <- params$ppi_out$by_module[[m]]
        n_mapped <- if (!is.null(ppi$n_mapped)) ppi$n_mapped else NA_integer_
        cat("<p><strong>Gene filter funnel:</strong> ",
            if (!is.null(ppi$n_seed)) ppi$n_seed else "?", " cluster seeds → ",
            if (!is.na(n_mapped)) paste0(n_mapped, " mapped to STRING → ") else "",
            if (!is.null(ppi$n_with_edge)) ppi$n_with_edge else "?",
            " with ≥1 STRING edge",
            if (!is.null(ppi$max_plot_nodes) && !is.null(ppi$n_with_edge) &&
                !is.null(ppi$n_plotted) && ppi$n_with_edge > ppi$n_plotted) {
              paste0(" → top ", ppi$n_plotted, " by degree plotted")
            } else if (!is.null(ppi$n_plotted)) {
              paste0(" → ", ppi$n_plotted, " plotted")
            } else {
              ""
            },
            ".</p>\n", sep = "")
        # Static embed (many interactive PPIs blow HTML memory).
        deseq2reports::emit_plot_with_download(
          ppi$plot,
          filename = paste0(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", m), "_ppi"),
          width = 6.5, height = 5.5
        )
        deseq2reports::bs_tab_pane_end()
      }
      deseq2reports::bs_tabset_end()
    }
  }

  # CSPA: top n_per_cluster genes per temporal cluster (embedded heatmap)
  if (!is.null(params$cspa_out) && identical(params$cspa_out$source, "lrt_clusters")) {
    entry <- params$cspa_out$by_lrt[[comp]]
    hm <- if (!is.null(entry)) entry$heatmap else params$cspa_out$heatmaps[[comp]]
    n_m <- if (!is.null(entry)) entry$n else NA_integer_
    n_pc <- if (!is.null(entry$n_per_cluster)) {
      entry$n_per_cluster
    } else if (!is.null(params$cspa_out$n_markers)) {
      params$cspa_out$n_markers
    } else {
      10L
    }
    cat("\n\n##### CSPA surface genes by cluster\n\n")
    cat("\n\nTop **", n_pc, "** Cell Surface Protein Atlas (CSPA) genes ",
        "**per degPatterns cluster**",
        if (!is.na(n_m)) paste0(" (", n_m, " genes plotted)") else "",
        ", ranked by LRT statistic; row annotation = cluster.\n\n", sep = "")
    cspa_pdf <- if (from_contrast_dir) {
      file.path("..", "cspa", comp, "cspa_cluster_heatmap.pdf")
    } else {
      file.path("cspa", comp, "cspa_cluster_heatmap.pdf")
    }
    cspa_csv <- if (from_contrast_dir) {
      file.path("..", "cspa", comp, "cspa_cluster_genes.csv")
    } else {
      file.path("cspa", comp, "cspa_cluster_genes.csv")
    }
    buttons <- list(
      deseq2reports::link_output_file(cspa_pdf, label = "Download heatmap PDF"),
      deseq2reports::link_output_file(cspa_csv, label = "Download genes CSV")
    )
    if (!is.null(hm) && !is.na(n_m) && n_m >= 2L) {
      dims <- .cspa_plot_dims(params$n_samples, n_m)
      content <- deseq2reports::capture_plot_tag(
        hm, width = dims$width, height = dims$height,
        alt = paste0("cspa_lrt_", comp)
      )
      deseq2reports::emit_widget(deseq2reports::wrap_with_corner_button(content, buttons))
    } else {
      deseq2reports::emit_widget(deseq2reports::wrap_with_corner_button(
        htmltools::tags$p("No CSPA heatmap available for this LRT."),
        buttons
      ))
    }
  }
  cat("\n\n")
}

emit_de_contrast <- function(comp, res_df, alpha, lfc_threshold,
                             ppi_out = NULL, cspa_out = NULL,
                             from_contrast_dir = FALSE) {
  n_sig <- sum(res_df$sig, na.rm = TRUE)
  cat("\n\n**", n_sig, "significant genes** (padj <", alpha,
      "& |log2FC| >", lfc_threshold, ")\n\n")

  cat("\n\n##### MA plot\n\nHover over a point to see its gene name, log2 fold-change, and adjusted p-value.\n\n")
  ma_plot <- deseq2reports::plot_ma(res_df, alpha = alpha, lfc_threshold = lfc_threshold)
  ma_btn <- deseq2reports::download_plot_button(ma_plot, filename = paste0(comp, "_MA_plot"))
  deseq2reports::emit_widget_with_download(deseq2reports::make_interactive(ma_plot), ma_btn, center = TRUE)

  cat("\n\n##### Volcano plot\n\nHover over a point to see its gene name, log2 fold-change, and adjusted p-value. ",
      "x-axis uses shrunken log2 fold-changes (only super-extreme outliers are clipped); ",
      "y-axis is -log10(padj). ",
      "Points are coloured up/down only when padj < alpha and |log2FC| > ", lfc_threshold, ".\n\n", sep = "")
  volcano_plot <- deseq2reports::plot_volcano(res_df, alpha = alpha, lfc_threshold = lfc_threshold)
  volcano_btn <- deseq2reports::download_plot_button(volcano_plot, filename = paste0(comp, "_volcano_plot"))
  deseq2reports::emit_widget_with_download(deseq2reports::make_interactive(volcano_plot), volcano_btn, center = TRUE)

  cat("\n\n##### DEG table\n\n")
  cat("\n\nTop ", 10, " up- and top ", 10,
      " down-ranked genes by `rank_score` are shown below (sort/search within this subset). ",
      "The full unfiltered results CSV is linked beside the table.\n\n", sep = "")
  deg_show <- deseq2reports::diffexp_top_bottom_table(res_df, top_n = 10)
  deg_csv <- if (from_contrast_dir) {
    paste0(comp, "_diffexp.csv")
  } else {
    file.path(comp, paste0(comp, "_diffexp.csv"))
  }
  deg_btn <- deseq2reports::link_output_file(deg_csv, label = "Download full CSV")
  deseq2reports::emit_widget_with_download(
    deseq2reports::make_deg_datatable(deg_show), deg_btn
  )

  ppi <- if (!is.null(ppi_out) && !is.null(ppi_out$by_comparison)) {
    ppi_out$by_comparison[[comp]]
  } else {
    NULL
  }
  emit_ppi_block(ppi, comp, from_contrast_dir)

  if (!is.null(cspa_out) && !is.null(cspa_out$heatmaps[[comp]]) &&
      !identical(cspa_out$source, "lrt_clusters")) {
    cat("\n\n##### CSPA surface markers\n\n")
    n_m <- if (!is.null(cspa_out$markers_by_comparison[[comp]])) {
      nrow(cspa_out$markers_by_comparison[[comp]])
    } else {
      NA_integer_
    }
    cat("\n\nTop ", if (!is.na(n_m)) n_m else cspa_out$n_markers,
        " Cell Surface Protein Atlas (CSPA) genes among this contrast's DEGs ",
        "(all CSPA categories; ranked by |rank_score|). ",
        "Heatmap shows **row-scaled VST** expression across **all samples**. ",
        "Marker table CSV and PDF live under `deseq2/cspa/", comp, "/`.\n\n", sep = "")
    hm <- cspa_out$heatmaps[[comp]]
    if (!is.null(hm)) {
      dims <- .cspa_plot_dims(params$n_samples, n_m)
      content <- deseq2reports::capture_plot_tag(
        hm, width = dims$width, height = dims$height,
        alt = paste0("cspa_", comp)
      )
      cspa_pdf <- if (from_contrast_dir) {
        file.path("..", "cspa", comp, "cspa_marker_heatmap.pdf")
      } else {
        file.path("cspa", comp, "cspa_marker_heatmap.pdf")
      }
      cspa_csv <- if (from_contrast_dir) {
        file.path("..", "cspa", comp, "cspa_markers.csv")
      } else {
        file.path("cspa", comp, "cspa_markers.csv")
      }
      btn <- deseq2reports::link_output_file(cspa_pdf, label = "Download heatmap PDF")
      btn2 <- deseq2reports::link_output_file(cspa_csv, label = "Download markers CSV")
      deseq2reports::emit_widget(deseq2reports::wrap_with_corner_button(content, list(btn, btn2)))
    }
  }
  cat("\n\n")
}

is_hub <- is.null(params$contrast) || !nzchar(as.character(params$contrast)[1])
contrast_page <- if (is_hub) NULL else as.character(params$contrast)[1]

specs <- params$diffexp_out$contrast_specs
if (is.null(specs)) {
  comps <- names(params$diffexp_out$by_comparison)
  specs <- data.frame(
    label = comps,
    class = if (is_lrt) "lrt" else "single",
    type = if (is_lrt) "lrt" else deseq2reports::classify_comparison_type(comps),
    stratum_var = NA_character_,
    stratum_level = NA_character_,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}
two_factor <- any(specs$class %in% c("within_A", "within_B", "interaction"))
```

```{r de-hub, results='asis', eval=is_hub}
cat("\n\n### ", if (is_lrt) "LRT tests" else "Contrasts", "\n\n", sep = "")
cat("Each ", if (is_lrt) "LRT" else "contrast",
    " has its own page to keep HTML size manageable:\n\n", sep = "")
for (comp in specs$label) {
  href <- file.path(comp, paste0(comp, ".html"))
  cat("- [**", comp, "**](", href, ")\n", sep = "")
}
cat("\n")
```

```{r de-contrast-page, results='asis', eval=!is_hub}
cat("\n\n### ", contrast_page, "\n\n", sep = "")
cat("<p><a href=\"../deseq2.html\">← Back to DESeq2 ",
    if (is_lrt) "LRT tests" else "contrasts", "</a></p>\n\n", sep = "")
if (is_lrt) {
  emit_lrt_contrast(
    contrast_page,
    params$diffexp_out$by_comparison[[contrast_page]],
    params$alpha,
    from_contrast_dir = TRUE
  )
} else {
  emit_de_contrast(
    contrast_page,
    params$diffexp_out$by_comparison[[contrast_page]],
    params$alpha, params$lfc_threshold,
    params$ppi_out, params$cspa_out,
    from_contrast_dir = TRUE
  )
}
```

```{r cspa-combined, results='asis', eval=is_hub && !is_lrt && !is.null(params$cspa_out) && !is.null(params$cspa_out$heatmaps$combined)}
cat("\n\n### Combined CSPA surface markers\n\n")
cat("\n\nUnion of per-contrast top Cell Surface Protein Atlas (CSPA) markers ",
    "(all categories; organism = **", params$cspa_out$org, "**, ",
    params$cspa_out$cspa_n, " CSPA genes). ",
    "Heatmap: row-scaled VST across **all samples**. ",
    nrow(params$cspa_out$combined_markers), " unique markers.\n\n", sep = "")
hm <- params$cspa_out$heatmaps$combined
n_m <- nrow(params$cspa_out$combined_markers)
dims <- .cspa_plot_dims(params$n_samples, n_m, combined = TRUE)
content <- deseq2reports::capture_plot_tag(
  hm, width = dims$width, height = dims$height, alt = "cspa_combined"
)
btn <- deseq2reports::link_output_file(
  "cspa/cspa_marker_heatmap_combined.pdf",
  label = "Download heatmap PDF"
)
btn2 <- deseq2reports::link_output_file(
  "cspa/cspa_markers_combined.csv",
  label = "Download markers CSV"
)
deseq2reports::emit_widget(deseq2reports::wrap_with_corner_button(content, list(btn, btn2)))
```
